{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "esol_size_ring_prior_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "short_smiles_favored",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": 0.55,
          "rationale": "Source ESOL value prior: smiles_short carried positive solubility effect; small solutes hydrate favorably."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "long_smiles_penalized",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Source prior gave smiles_long the largest negative effect; large hydrophobic solutes desolvate poorly."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_free_bonus",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_none"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Ring role had the highest transfer weight; rigid ring systems reduced solubility in source data."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "low_branching_bonus",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_low"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Rotatable-bond role maps to branching; modest flexibility limited entropic desolvation penalty in source."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.35,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.45,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.15,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.45,
      "hypothesis": "Transfers ESOL size, ring and branching effects to hydration ranking. May fail because aqueous solubility mixes crystal-lattice terms absent from pure hydration free energy, and source role confidences are only 0.22-0.41."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polar_hydration_counter_prior",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_hydration",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.6,
          "rationale": "N/O heteroatoms donate and accept hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "pure_hydrocarbon_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none"},
          "weight": -0.55,
          "rationale": "Apolar hydrocarbons pay a cavity-formation cost with no compensating polar solvation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_free_bonus",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_none"},
          "weight": 0.35,
          "rationale": "Halogenation raises hydrophobicity and weakens water hydrogen bonding despite added polarizability."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "midlength_counterprior",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: reverses the weakly supported negative smiles_mid source prior; moderate size allows more polar groups."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.8,
      "prior_scale": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.2,
      "ucb_weight": 0.5,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.2,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "hypothesis": "Hydration is driven by polar hydrogen-bonding capacity rather than molecular size, so it reverses the mid-length source penalty. Fails if the score rewards small apolar solutes or if hetero_high coverage (28 items) is unrepresentative."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polar_hydration_counter_prior",
  "lesson": "Source ESOL effects are size- and ring-dominated with low confidence (0.16-0.41), while hydration free energy is mechanistically governed by polar hydrogen bonding; prefer the mechanism-first prior and keep semantic mass decaying so revealed target data can override it.",
  "revision_summary": "Kept a trimmed source-grounded skill using only the explicit smiles_length value priors plus the two highest-transfer-weight roles (ring, branch). Added a counter-hypothesis domain skill that reverses the smiles_mid penalty and centers heteroatom and halogen-free polarity. Both capped at four catalog-exact rules with decaying semantic mass; deployed the mechanistic hydration skill."
}
